name: ajusted-for-jeans
description: Find the right women's size at another brand for jeans, pants and jackets, from one item that already fits or your measurements, using official brand size charts.

interface.longDescription:
Ajusted finds your size at another brand for women's jeans, pants and jackets. Tell it one item that fits you (the brand and the size), or your measurements, and the brand or product you want to buy. It returns the size to order, a confidence level, and why: your measurements against that brand's chart. If you're between two sizes it says which way to go, and it says what a size chart can't tell you, such as rise, stretch or room for layering.

Every answer comes from each brand's official body size chart, checked by hand before it is added. Ajusted does not guess, and it uses body measurements only, never garment measurements.

What you can ask:
- "I wear a 28 in Levi's. What size should I get at Aritzia?"
- "I'm a medium in The North Face. What size Canada Goose coat should I order?"
- "My bust is 36 inches. What size is this Patagonia jacket for me?" with a product link
- "Which jacket brands does Ajusted cover?"

Coverage: jeans and pants at more than 30 brands, including Levi's, Gap, Old Navy, American Eagle, Abercrombie & Fitch, Madewell, H&M, Uniqlo, Aritzia, AGOLDE and True Religion; jackets and coats at 10 brands: Aritzia, Canada Goose, Arc'teryx, Lululemon, The North Face, Patagonia, Uniqlo, Columbia, Mackage and Roots. New brands are added regularly. Petite, tall, curvy and plus sizes are supported where the brand publishes them.

Limits: women's jeans, pants and jackets only. No men's sizes, dresses, tops or shoes yet. A size answer is an estimate, not a guarantee of fit; fabric, stretch and cut vary by style. For brands whose sizing changes from listing to listing (such as SHEIN), Ajusted does not give an instant answer and instead offers a size by email within 24 hours at getajusted.com.

No account or sign-in needed. Ajusted is independent and is not affiliated with any of the brands it covers.
